hebrewText: יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְ/מַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ

tokens.bdb: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
tokens.kjv: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.enLiteralWord: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.explanation: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.explanationEn: to gather grapes; also to be isolated

tokens.bdb: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
tokens.kjv: air, anger, blast, breath, [idiom] cool, courage, mind, [idiom] quarter, [idiom] side, spirit(-ual), tempest, [idiom] vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).
tokens.explanation: ruach — espírito, vento, sopro, alento de vida

tokens.bdb: a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes
tokens.kjv: captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

tokens.bdb: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
tokens.kjv: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra
